actors.name: Kettlewell Allotment Society
actors.private_context: The society needs a chair for the upcoming year. The current chair is stepping down. The society has members who may or may not volunteer.

shared_context: The Kettlewell allotment society's chair is stepping down. Nominations for the new chair close at the annual general meeting in five weeks (by 2026-09-29). The society has a membership that can nominate themselves or others for the position.

starting_events.description: The current chair announces their intention to step down, and the society opens nominations for the position of chair, to be closed at the annual general meeting in five weeks.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the annual general meeting (by 2026-09-29T20:00:00+01:00), at least one person has formally volunteered or been nominated to stand for chair, as recorded in the society's nomination records. Otherwise resolve NO at the meeting's nomination deadline.
